demand_drivers.body:
- Government continues to give high priority to the infrastructure sector through ongoing policy support and investments, which the Company expects to translate into growth opportunities.
- Rising raw material costs (steel, cement, bitumen), supply chain delays and skilled-labour shortages are tightening execution timelines and impacting margins industry-wide.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company continues to face liquidity challenges, with a significant portion of its funds locked in ongoing project-related disputes, limiting financial flexibility and its ability to respond to new opportunities and operational requirements.
- Prolonged litigation, challenges to arbitration awards, and adverse tax rulings continue to block significant funds and put pressure on liquidity.
- Rising raw material costs — particularly steel, cement, and bitumen — add financial pressure on project execution.
- Ongoing supply chain delays and skilled labour shortages tighten timelines and impact margins in project execution.
- The Company remains exposed to fluctuations in GDP growth, interest rates, inflation, and taxation policies, which may affect project viability, operating costs, and overall profitability.
- The fragmented nature of the real estate sector, coupled with the absence of a single-window clearance system, contributes to operational inefficiencies and increased project costs; delays in project approvals also adversely impact execution timelines and profitability.
- Potential tightening of real estate financing by banks and financial institutions could adversely affect the Company's borrowing capacity and increase financing costs.
- The Company's fleet is aging, requiring modernization to maintain operational efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness in a demanding market environment.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Construction: continues to explore new growth opportunities aligned with its core capabilities and strategic objectives, actively pursuing new construction contracts and emerging opportunities in the sector.
- Hotel: exploring renovation and upgradation of facilities and modern amenities to enhance guest experience, and evaluating cultivation of vacant land adjacent to the hotel premises to optimise resource utilisation and generate additional revenue.
- Actively pursuing out-of-court settlements of ongoing project-related disputes to unlock blocked capital and improve liquidity.
